conviction_note: The bar is the company's own Q1 revenue plan of ¥1,400m (+48% YoY), set on 07-14 when the quarter was already six weeks old and backed by ¥2,025m of inventory, ¥1,597m of supplier prepayments and a ¥2,230m backlog at the start of the quarter. The company's own statement that its GPU campaign sold out two weeks early, with price rises announced for the next shipments, leans positive. Against that, the stock has sold 7 of its last 11 prints, including both upward-revision days, and retail margin longs are building into this one. So p_up is only 53 on an abs_move of 5.5, giving +0.33, close to the findings' sum of +0.4.
bar: Q1 FY5/27 revenue ¥1,400m (15.8% of the ¥8,840m full-year plan), from the company's own quarterly revenue outlook on slides 25-26 of the FY5/26 supplementary deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592230.pdf, 2026-07-14). The company gives no quarterly profit guide; the full-year OP plan is ¥1,268m at a 14.4% margin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592187.pdf). No 四季報 or IFIS number was reachable, so the only bar is the company's, and the findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.51% (prev 0.47%, +0.04pp), one seller, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the baseline). Margin balances from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=5885, read 2026-10-14): margin shorts 37.4k shares on 09-11 falling to 15.2k on 10-09, margin longs 75.2k rising to 87.0k, so 信用倍率 went from 2.01 to 5.72. Margin longs are about 1.6% of the 5.498m shares and about 3.5 days of average volume. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct is +0.31.

findings.finding: The company's own quarterly outlook puts Q1 revenue at ¥1,400m (+48% YoY against ¥948m). It set that figure on 07-14, six weeks into the quarter, after building inventory to ¥2,025m (+110%) and supplier prepayments to ¥1,597m (from zero) by May-end, and against a flow backlog of ¥2,230m (+72%). That makes the Q1 revenue line likely to land at or above plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 prints, measured close to next close on the actual dates: 2024-10-11 +16.45% (Q1 revenue +74% YoY); 2025-10-14 -2.76% (Q1 revenue -24% YoY, OP flat). The stock fell on both upward-revision prints (2025-04-14 -5.23%, 2026-04-14 -4.69%) and on the FY print with its +13.6% OP guide (2026-07-14 -8.01%).
findings.why_not_priced: The plan and the balance sheet have been public since 07-14, so this mostly lands inside guidance and is sized near 0. What is not public is whether the stockpiled inventory converted inside Q1. If the market were confident it had, the stock would not have given back the whole August-September rally (3,500 on 09-07 to 3,005 now, -9.3% over 20 days) into the print.
findings.independence: The Fisco memo of 2026-08-18 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5885&b=n202608180609) repeats the same backlog and inventory facts, so it is the same document read twice and adds nothing independent. The large-order notice of 2026-04-27 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/58850/140120260424510864.pdf, ¥1.6bn, delivery in FY5/27) is separate, but it is the Q3 project and does not bear on Q1.

findings.finding: The company's own notice says its RTX PRO 6000 'Summer Dragon' campaign (run 06-22 to 09-30) drew orders above expectation and was closed on 09-15 at the planned quantity. The same notice says prices on the next shipments will rise because purchase costs went up, which favours the margin on the ¥2,025m of inventory bought before those increases.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print where a campaign or a margin line was isolated. The FY5/26 OP beat came from gross margin (+4.8pp to 25.0%), and the stock still fell 8.0% on that print because the guide was weak.
findings.why_not_priced: It appeared only as a product notice on the corporate site, not on TDnet, and nothing on kabutan picked it up. It also does not show in the tape: the stock drifted down 3,155 to 3,005 from 09-17 to 10-14 with no reaction around 09-08 or 09-15. The size is capped because the unit count is not disclosed, part of the order flow falls into Q2, and the campaign price is a discount.
findings.independence: The launch release on PR TIMES (https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000025.000019489.html, 2026-06-22) confirms the window and the ¥1.65m unit price. The Fisco memo of 2026-08-18 independently describes component prices rising across the board and the inventory build as a countermeasure (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5885&b=n202608180609).

findings.finding: Per its large-holding report, Nomura Asset Management cut its stake from 4.19% to 3.22% by 2026-09-30, taking Nomura's group total below 5% (5.27% to 4.22%). That is an institutional seller leaving ahead of the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent. The filing became public on 10-07 and the stock fell 4.9% on 10-08.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced: the selling happened before 09-30 and the tape absorbed the filing on 10-08. What is left is the chance the fund keeps selling after the print, so it is sized near 0.

findings.finding: Retail margin positioning has turned one-sided into the print. Margin shorts were covered from 37.4k to 15.2k shares while margin longs rose from 75.2k to 87.0k over four weeks, taking 信用倍率 from 2.01 to 5.72. That leaves leveraged holders who sell on a disappointing print, and few shorts left to squeeze on a good one.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell on 7 of its last 11 prints, measured on the actual release dates from the Yahoo daily tape (median absolute move about 5.2%), including two upward-revision prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's lean has a -0.38 margin-overhang term but nets to +0.31 on short-squeeze and run-up terms. The squeeze term overstates the fuel: the margin short side has already covered about 60%. If the market priced the overhang, the margin longs would not still be adding as the price falls.
findings.independence: The baseline's lean_components.margin_overhang (-0.379) reads the same margin ratio, so it is not independent.

outside_window.finding: A ¥1.6bn large order (AI servers and solutions) is due for delivery in FY5/27; the company's quarterly outlook books it in Q3 (Dec-Feb), with Q3 revenue planned at ¥3,441m.
The SoftBank 'AI data center GPU server' sales-partner agreement (2026-08-05) adds recurring revenue over the medium term, not in Q1.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet/kabutan disclosure list for 5885 from 2026-07-14 to 2026-10-14: no 業績予想の修正, no 配当予想の修正, no buyback (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5885)
Company IR news page (https://info.gdep.co.jp/ir/news/): no Q1 pre-announcement
Forecast-revision record: past revisions came only at Q3 (2025-04-14, 2026-04-14) and in June, never at Q1, and the company says it manages to an annual plan with no H1 guide (FY5/26 短信 p.1)

四季報 / IFIS consensus for FY5/27: not reachable without login; the only external estimate found is Fisco's valuation report (target ¥5,022, says the guide may be conservative, gives no Q1 number) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5885&b=n202608210450)
Interim dividend or 優待 at Q1: the company pays a year-end dividend only (¥48 planned), so no capital-return item is expected at this print
Search for new large orders or deliveries from July to October 2026: nothing beyond the April ¥1.6bn order
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5885&page=3 (the FY5/26 決算短信 and every disclosure since are stamped 15:30; last year's Q1 is listed as 25/10/14 on https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5885)
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected; the company has never revised at Q1 and manages to an annual plan. Returns: none expected; year-end dividend only, ¥48 planned. New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter: the company's own Q1 revenue plan is ¥1,400m (15.8% progress); last year's Q1 progress was 13.6% of revenue and 14.9% of OP, and FY5/25 was 18.8% / 21.0%.

rejected_candidates.detail: Restates the backlog, inventory and prepayment figures in the 07-14 deck; merged into finding 1.

rejected_candidates.detail: Package offering with no stated Q1 revenue; any contribution comes after the exit window.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with the baseline. The lean is +0.31 and my findings sum to +0.4, but they rest on the company's own plan and a product notice, not a new number, and they cut against the name's habit of selling prints and against margin longs building. Per rule 2, the strongest positive this release could carry is Q1 revenue clearly above ¥1,400m with a gross margin lifted by low-cost inventory; I looked for it, and found support in the inventory and the sold-out campaign but no figure.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives, check the sign): the two negatives are both positioning, not fundamentals. I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for it.
Open question 4 (a positioning short into a print was wrong once): margin-long crowding cut from -0.6 to -0.4. The Nomura AM sale cut from -0.2 to -0.1, since the tape absorbed it on 10-08.

Rule 1 (negatives on public series): not applicable, because no finding is a negative built on a 月次 or a visible 進捗率 miss. abs_move_pct and p_up are unchanged; print_vs_bar trimmed from +3 to +2 because no external bar was found.
